# AGENTS.md — opencode-translate-selection

Project instructions, architectural invariants, and verification workflows for AI coding agents working on `opencode-translate-selection`.

---

## 🧭 Project Overview

`opencode-translate-selection` is an official-grade OpenCode plugin providing:
- **OpenCode Desktop**: Instant inline floating translation tooltip directly on mouse text selection, cleanly positioned above the native `[ ❝ Quote ]` bar.
- **OpenCode TUI / Terminal**: Hotkeys (`Alt+T`, `Alt+Shift+T`, `Alt+P`), slash commands (`/translate`, `/translate-last`, `/translate-panel`, `/translate-config`), scrollable translation modal dialog, interactive sidebar panel (`session.panel`), and system clipboard integration.
- **Smart Hybrid Translation Routing**: Simple phrases go through instant MT (Google Translate / MyMemory, ~100ms, 0 tokens); multi-line or structured text (bullet points, numbered steps, code signatures, function calls) routes to the active session LLM outside chat context.

---

## 🛠️ Build & Verification Pipeline

Always verify changes using the official npm scripts before completing tasks. Never assume a build or test passes without running:

```bash
# 1. Typecheck TypeScript against @opencode/plugin SDK
npm run typecheck

# 2. Run test suite using native Node.js 22 test runner
npm test

# 3. Compile both GUI (Vite) and TUI (build-tui.mjs) bundles
npm run build

# 4. Full CI verification gate (typecheck + test + build)
npm run ci
```

> **Testing Note**: The test runner is Node's built-in `node --experimental-strip-types --test "test/**/*.test.ts"`. Do **not** install or configure Jest or Vitest.

---

## 📐 Dual Build Pipeline

The project compiles into two distinct artifacts:
1. **GUI (Desktop)**: Bundled via Vite + SolidJS (`vite.config.ts`) $\to$ `dist/gui-experimental.cjs`.
2. **TUI (Terminal)**: Bundled via `build-tui.mjs` (Esbuild + Babel with Solid preset) $\to$ `dist/tui.js`.

Running `npm run build` executes both in sequence (`vite build && node build-tui.mjs`).

---

## ⚠️ Architectural Invariants & Safety Rules

1. **Zero Context Pollution (LLM Translations)**:
   - LLM translations MUST run through `client.session.generate()`.
   - **Never** inject translation requests or temporary prompts into the conversation chat history (`client.session.prompt` or message mutation).
   - Translation generation must remain completely invisible to the user's ongoing session context.

2. **Dual-Process Separation**:
   - **Window / Renderer Process** (`src/popup.tsx`, `src/settings-view.tsx`, `src/formatter-view.tsx`, `src/gui.tsx`):
     - Renders inside OpenCode Desktop DOM tree with SolidJS.
     - Mounts in the `window.bottom` slot and projects floating popups via `<Portal>`.
     - Handles mouse selection (`window.getSelection()`), layout geometry, and UI state.
     - **No direct Node.js network calls** — delegates all background work over the typed IPC contract.
   - **Main / Background Process** (`src/translate.ts`, `src/llm-engine.ts`, `src/shield.ts`, `src/detector.ts`):
     - Handles network requests (Google Translate `gtx`/`dict-chrome-ex`, MyMemory API fallback).
     - Manages the LRU translation cache (500 items).
     - Communicates with session LLM outside conversation history.
   - **IPC Contract** (`src/contract.ts`):
     - Typed boundary between Window and Main using Effect `Schema`.

3. **Preserve Root Entry Shims**:
   - `server.ts`, `tui.ts`, and `tui.tsx` at the package root are required by OpenCode's local plugin resolver when developing plugins from a local directory.
   - **Do not delete, rename, or move these root shims into `src/`**.

4. **Token Shielding (`⟦0⟧`) & Code Protection**:
   - `src/shield.ts` implements mathematical token shielding (`⟦0⟧`, `⟦1⟧`, etc.) to protect code blocks, backticks, and identifier syntax from being mangled by MT engines.
   - Any changes to `src/detector.ts`, `src/shield.ts`, or `src/llm-engine.ts` must be accompanied by new or updated unit tests in `test/`.

5. **Localization (i18n)**:
   - When adding UI strings or settings options to `src/i18n.ts`, ensure corresponding translations are provided across all supported locales (`en`, `ru`, `zh`, `ja`, `de`, `fr`, `es`).
   - `test/i18n.test.ts` automatically asserts key parity across all language dictionaries.

6. **Terminal TUI Compatibility**:
   - TUI components in `src/tui.tsx` rely on `@opentui/core` and `@opentui/solid`.
   - Modals and panels must handle narrow terminal widths gracefully and clean up event listeners / subscriptions on unmount.

# opencode-translate-selection [![OpenCode Desktop](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCode_Desktop-v2.2.0+-blue.svg?logo=electron&logoColor=white)](https://opencode.ai/) [![OpenCode TUI](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCode_TUI-v2.2.0+-green.svg?logo=gnubash&logoColor=white)](https://opencode.ai/) [![CI](https://github.com/Realmagnum/opencode-translate-selection/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Realmagnum/opencode-translate-selection/actions) [![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-5.9-3178c6.svg?logo=typescript&logoColor=white)](https://www.typescriptlang.org/) [![SolidJS](https://img.shields.io/badge/SolidJS-1.9-2c4f7c.svg?logo=solid&logoColor=white)](https://www.solidjs.com/) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE) **Instant inline translation tooltip on text selection for OpenCode Desktop & Full Terminal TUI Support with Smart Hybrid LLM/MT routing — supports all languages.**
--- > [!IMPORTANT] > **Requires OpenCode v2.2.0 or newer**. > - **In OpenCode Desktop**: Provides an instant floating translation tooltip on text selection directly above the native **Quote** toolbar. > - **In OpenCode TUI / Terminal**: Provides conflict-free hotkeys (`Alt+T`, `Alt+Shift+T`, `Alt+P`), slash commands (`/translate`, `/translate-last`, `/translate-panel`, `/translate-config`), a scrollable multiline translation modal, an interactive side panel (`session.panel`), and seamless clipboard integration. --- ## ✨ Features - **Zero-friction workflow**: Just select text with your mouse. The translation appears automatically after a subtle 140ms debounce. - **Smart positioning**: Floats cleanly **above** the built-in `[ ❝ Quote ]` toolbar (`QUOTE_CLEARANCE = 52px`), without overlapping or jumping. - **Smart Hybrid Translation**: - **Simple phrases & words**: Translated instantly via Google Translate (~100ms) with zero token usage. - **Complex structures & code**: Multi-line selections (bullet lists `•`, numbered steps `1.`, function calls like `tools.opencode.models()`, parameter objects) automatically route to the **active session's LLM** outside conversation history. - **Zero context pollution**: LLM translations run via `client.session.generate()`, so they never add messages to your chat or consume conversation context. - **Fail-safe Fallback with Token Shielding**: If the LLM times out (> 3.5s) or is busy, requests seamlessly fall back to the multi-tier MT pipeline with mathematical token shielding (`⟦0⟧`) protecting code and identifiers. - **Universal Language Support & Smart Filtering**: Works with **any language** supported by Google Translate (130+ languages) and your session's LLM — including Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, English, German, French, Spanish, and more. Automatically detects the source language, translates into your configured target languages (`ru, en` by default or any custom list in Settings), and intelligently hides the target that matches the source (e.g. selecting English text shows only Russian; selecting Chinese or Japanese displays Russian and English; or configure a single target like `ru` to translate everything exclusively into Russian). - **Structured Popup Rendering**: - Clean bullet tags (`•`), numbered steps (`1.`), and indentations. - Inline code highlighted in monospace font on subtle background chips: ``. - Subtle `LLM` tag badge when translated via session model. - Vertical scroll containment (`maxHeight = 420px`) for long multi-item lists. - **High-contrast warm dark theme**: Deep olive background (`rgba(43, 34, 10, 0.97)`), bright yellow translation text (`#ffd75e`), and golden language badges (`#c9a83f`). - **One-click copy**: Click on any translated block to copy full formatted Markdown to your clipboard. - **Multi-tier MT engine**: Google Translate (`gtx` + `dict-chrome-ex`) with MyMemory API fallback. - **In-memory LRU cache**: Keeps up to 500 recent translations in memory for instant lookups with zero network overhead. - **Dedicated GUI Settings**: Full-featured settings page (`/settings?tab=translate`) with an embedded Live Preview, Engine Mode selector (Auto / Fast MT / Session LLM), LLM timeout slider, 5 color presets, and geometry controls. - **Zero runtime footprint**: Built as an ultra-compact single file bundle (`37 KB` unminified / `12 KB` gzip) running in OpenCode's SolidJS environment. --- ## 📦 Installation ### Option A: Install from GitHub ```bash opencode plugin add github:Realmagnum/opencode-translate-selection ``` Restart OpenCode Desktop after installation. ### Option B: Local development / manual installation 1. Clone the repository: ```bash git clone https://github.com/Realmagnum/opencode-translate-selection.git \ ~/Documents/!Projects/opencode-translate-selection cd ~/Documents/!Projects/opencode-translate-selection npm install npm run build ``` 2. Add the absolute path to `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`: ```jsonc { "plugins": [ "/Users/you/Documents/!Projects/opencode-translate-selection" ] } ``` 3. Restart OpenCode Desktop once. Subsequent edits via `npm run watch` reload the GUI automatically in real time without needing an app restart! --- ## 💻 Terminal (TUI) Usage When running OpenCode in your terminal (`opencode`), the plugin automatically activates its first-class TUI module powered by OpenTUI (`@opentui/solid` & `@opentui/core`) with zero configuration required. ### ⌨️ Keybindings & Slash Commands All hotkeys are conflict-free and don't clash with OpenCode's native keys: | Keybind | Command / Slash | Description | |---|---|---| | `Alt+T` | `/translate [text]` (alias: `/tr`) | **Translate clipboard text** (or custom prompt if clipboard is empty). If the side panel is open, updates the panel in-place; otherwise opens a scrollable modal dialog. | | `Alt+Shift+T` | `/translate-last` (alias: `/trl`) | **Translate last assistant message** from active session. Out-of-band translation with zero session history pollution. | | `Alt+P` | `/translate-panel` (alias: `/trp`) | **Toggle side panel** (`session.panel`) for persistent side-by-side reading. | | — | `/translate-config` | Open interactive TUI settings (target languages, engine mode: `AUTO` / `FAST` / `LLM`). | *(All commands are also discoverable in the command palette via `Ctrl+P`).* --- ### 🪟 Scrollable Multiline Translation Modal

When the side panel is closed, pressing `Alt+T` opens a centered, high-contrast modal dialog: - **Full Multiline Text & Word Wrapping**: Unlike standard one-line menus, translations render with complete word wrapping (`wrapMode="word"`). Long paragraphs, code snippets, and lists are displayed without truncation. - **Smooth Keyboard & Mouse Scrolling**: Dedicated `` navigable via `↑`/`↓`, `j`/`k`, `PageUp`/`PageDown`, or mouse wheel. - **One-Click Actions**: - `y`: Copy translation to system clipboard. - `Enter`: Copy translation to clipboard and immediately dismiss the modal. - `p`: Transfer current translation into the persistent side panel and close the modal. - `q` / `Esc`: Dismiss the modal. --- ### 📑 Persistent Side Panel (`session.panel`)

Press `Alt+P` or run `/translate-panel` to open a persistent translation sidebar alongside your active chat session. #### 🔄 Seamless In-Place Updates When the side panel is already open, pressing `Alt+T` (clipboard) or `Alt+Shift+T` (last turn) **never spawns popup dialogs**. It seamlessly translates the text and **reactively updates the translation in-place inside the panel**, accompanied by a subtle confirmation toast (`✓ Перевод обновлён в панели`). #### 🎮 Panel Hotkeys & Focus Control When the panel has focus (indicated by a green `[фокус]` badge in the top right; click anywhere in the panel to focus): - **`t`**: Translate current clipboard contents. - **`l`**: Translate the last assistant message. - **`y`**: Copy full formatted Markdown translation to clipboard. - **`m`**: Cycle engine mode on the fly (`AUTO` ⇄ `FAST` ⇄ `LLM`). - **`f`**: Toggle full-screen mode (expands panel across the entire terminal for reading lengthy documentation). - **`q`** or **`Esc`**: Close the side panel. - **`↑`/`↓`, `j`/`k`, `PageUp`/`PageDown`**: Scroll through translation text. --- ### ⌨️ Customizable Keybindings (Ghostty & Custom Terminals) If your terminal emulator (such as **Ghostty**, iTerm2, Alacritty, or Kitty) intercepts `Alt+T` for native window/tab shortcuts, you can easily customize all translation shortcuts:

1. **Via Desktop GUI Settings** (`Settings > Translation > Terminal (TUI) Keybindings`): - Edit **Translate Clipboard Hotkey** (e.g. `alt+y`, `ctrl+t`, `alt+c`). - Edit **Translate Last Turn Hotkey** (e.g. `alt+shift+y`, `ctrl+shift+t`). - Edit **Toggle Side Panel Hotkey** (e.g. `alt+o`, `ctrl+p`). - All changes instantly sync to your terminal configuration! 2. **Directly in the Terminal** (`/translate-config`): - Select **Горячие клавиши** to change key combinations interactively on the fly. --- ### ⚙️ Interactive TUI Configuration (`/translate-config`) Run `/translate-config` inside any terminal session to configure settings stored durably via `context.storage.store`: 1. **Target Languages**: Edit comma-separated ISO language codes (e.g. `ru, en` or a single target like `ru`). 2. **Engine Mode**: - `Auto (Smart Hybrid)`: Fast Google MT (~100ms) for single words/phrases; Session LLM for structured lists and code. - `Fast MT Only`: 100% Google Translate / MyMemory with zero token usage. - `Session LLM Only`: Always translate using the session's active model. 3. **Reset to Defaults**: Quickly restore default preferences. --- ### 📋 Cross-Platform Clipboard Integration Translations can be copied and pasted seamlessly regardless of your operating system: - **macOS**: Native `pbpaste` / `pbcopy`. - **Linux**: Automatic detection of Wayland (`wl-paste` / `wl-copy`) and X11 (`xclip` / `xsel`). - **Windows**: PowerShell clipboard interoperability. - **OSC 52**: Terminal escape sequence fallback for remote SSH sessions. --- ## ⚙️ Settings (GUI) The plugin integrates seamlessly with OpenCode Desktop's Settings: ### 1. Plugin Management (`Settings > Extensions > Plugins`) The plugin automatically registers with OpenCode's native extensions manager. You can reload its GUI or toggle it on/off at any time without restarting OpenCode:

### 2. Dedicated Configuration (`Settings > Translation`) A dedicated **Translation** page is added directly to OpenCode Desktop's Settings (`/settings?tab=translate`, icon: `globe`).

You can customize everything in real-time with an **interactive Live Preview**: - **Engine Mode**: - `Auto (Smart)` *(Default)*: Google MT for single phrases; Session LLM for structured lists and code. - `Fast MT Only`: Always use Google / MyMemory (fastest, zero LLM usage). - `Session LLM Only`: Always translate using the active session's model. - **LLM Fallback Timeout**: Configurable wait time (1.5s – 8.0s) before falling back to Google Translate. - **Theme Presets & Custom Colors**: Switch instantly between *Amber Gold*, *Midnight OLED*, *Cyberpunk*, *Nordic Slate*, or *Paper Light*, or pick custom background, text, and accent/badge colors, and adjust backdrop opacity (40% – 100%).

- **Position & Dimensions**: - Quote clearance height (20px – 100px). - Corner border-radius (0px – 24px). - Maximum tooltip width (300px – 800px). - Maximum tooltip height (200px – 700px). - Text font size (10px – 18px).

- **Target Languages**: Edit comma-separated ISO language codes (e.g. `ru, en, de, fr, es, zh, ja, ko`). Includes direct reference link to ISO 639-1 language codes. Supports **any language** understood by Google Translate (130+ languages) or your active LLM. Set a single code like `ru` to translate all foreign text (English, Chinese, etc.) strictly into Russian. - **Behavior**: Adjust selection debounce delay (60ms – 400ms) and character limits (200 – 2500).

- **Reset**: Restore defaults with one click. All changes are saved automatically via OpenCode's `Store.global` and apply instantly without restarting OpenCode. --- ## 🛠️ Architecture & How It Works ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph UI ["Desktop Window (SolidJS Renderer)"] direction TB SEL["User selects text in timeline"] --> DET{"isComplexFormattedText?"} DET -->|Simple phrase| FAST["Mode: Fast MT"] DET -->|Bullets / Code / Lists| HYBRID["Mode: Session LLM"] end subgraph MAIN ["Electron Main Process (Node.js)"] direction TB HYBRID --> LLM["LLM Engine (client.session.generate)"] LLM -->|Success < 3.5s| RES["Preserved Markdown Translation"] LLM -->|Timeout or Error| FALLBACK["Token Shielding (⟦0⟧)"] FAST --> FALLBACK FALLBACK --> MT["Multi-tier MT (Google / MyMemory)"] MT --> UN["Unshield Tokens"] UN --> RES end RES --> POPUP["Solid <Portal> Popup above Quote toolbar"] POPUP -->|Click line| CLIP["Copy Markdown to clipboard"] ``` 1. **Window setup (`src/gui.tsx`)**: Mounts a non-intrusive reactive surface into the `window.bottom` slot. 2. **Selection & Popup (`src/popup.tsx`)**: Tracks mouse release on the document, reads the active `Selection` range, measures coordinates, and portals a fixed-position popup above the native Quote toolbar. 3. **Electron Main Bridge (`src/translate.ts`)**: Translation requests run in the Electron main process via typed OpenCode `Ipc`, bypassing renderer CORS or Content Security Policy restrictions completely. 4. **Session LLM Generation (`src/llm-engine.ts`)**: Executes outside conversation history via `client.session.generate({ sessionID, prompt })`, producing symbol-for-symbol accurate translations without polluting the user's session. --- ## ⚠️ Known Limitations - **DOM text only**: Works across the chat timeline, tool cards, markdown messages, and sidebar panels. Does **not** work on text inside the integrated terminal, because the terminal renders to an HTML5 canvas (ghostty-web) where text selection does not produce DOM nodes. - **Input fields**: Text selection inside textareas, inputs, or the prompt composer is intentionally ignored to avoid interfering with typing. --- ## 💻 Development & Testing ```bash npm run typecheck # Typecheck TypeScript against @opencode/plugin npm test # Run 15 unit tests (detector, shield, formatter, llm-engine) npm run build # Build dist/gui-experimental.cjs (Vite + Solid) npm run watch # Watch & rebuild on changes (auto-reloads GUI in OpenCode) npm run ci # Full CI suite: typecheck + test + build ``` --- ## 📄 License [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 [Realmagnum](https://github.com/Realmagnum)

## [0.3.3] - 2026-10-29

### Added
- **ISO 639-1 Language Code Reference Link**:
  - Added a convenient external link in the Settings page (`Target Languages` card) directing users to the standardized list of two-letter language codes (e.g. `ru`, `en`, `fr`, `de`, `es`, `zh`, `ja`, etc.).
  - The link dynamically opens the native language Wikipedia article corresponding to the user's interface language (e.g. Russian Wikipedia for `ru`, English for `en`, German for `de`, etc.) via `ctx.system.openExternal`.
  - Added reference link to the TUI `/translate-config` target languages prompt description.

---

## [0.3.2] - 2026-10-28

### Added
- **Full Dynamic Internationalization (i18n) for Plugin Settings & UI**:
  - The entire Settings page, preset names, live preview mockup, control labels, section titles, and action buttons now dynamically adapt to the active interface and system language.
  - Comprehensive localization catalogs added for major world languages:
    - English (`en`, `en-US`, `en-GB`)
    - Russian (`ru`, `ru-RU`)
    - Simplified & Traditional Chinese (`zh`, `zh-CN`, `zh-Hans`, `zht`, `zh-TW`, `zh-Hant`)
    - German (`de`, `de-DE`)
    - Spanish (`es`, `es-ES`)
    - French (`fr`, `fr-FR`)
    - Japanese (`ja`, `ja-JP`)
  - Reactive `SettingsPage` factory registration (`ctx.add(SettingsPage, () => ({ ... }))`) ensuring the settings navigation sidebar label updates instantly when switching language in OpenCode.
  - Dynamic getters in `TranslationSurface` labels ensuring the popup tooltip labels re-render reactively.
  - Intelligent default target languages on reset (`getDefaultTargetsForLocale`), adapting default targets to the active system locale (`ru, en`, `zh, en`, `de, en`, `es, en`, `fr, en`, `ja, en`, etc.).
  - Added locale awareness to terminal TUI dialogs and commands, automatically displaying in Russian or English based on system locale (`LANG`, `LC_ALL`, `Intl`).
- **Comprehensive i18n Test Suite**:
  - Added unit tests verifying key completeness across all 7 supported dictionaries, parameter interpolation, country-code matching, fallback behavior, and locale-based defaults (28 unit tests, 100% passing).

### Removed
- Removed outdated `STRUCTURED-TRANSLATION-SPEC.md`.

---

## [0.3.1] - 2026-10-28

### Added
- **Customizable TUI Keybindings**:
  - Configure keybindings directly from the Desktop GUI (`Settings > Translation > Terminal (TUI) Keybindings`) or interactively in the terminal via `/translate-config > Горячие клавиши`.
  - Fixes shortcut collisions with terminal emulators (e.g. Ghostty's native `Alt+T`, iTerm2, Alacritty) by allowing users to set any key combinations (e.g. `alt+y`, `ctrl+t`, `alt+c`).
  - Seamless two-way persistence: keybinding changes made in GUI settings are saved to TUI state (`plugin.translate-selection.tui-settings.json`) and vice-versa.
- **TUI Visual Documentation**:
  - Added screenshots of the multiline scrollable modal dialog (`assets/tui-modal.png`) and the responsive side panel (`assets/tui-panel.png`) to README.
- **Enhanced Symmetrical Modal & Responsive Panel Layout**:
  - Removed asymmetric borders in `TranslationModal` to match native OpenCode modal dialogs.
  - Redesigned side panel header and footer for narrow terminal widths (30–40 columns): non-breaking chip-based hotkey legend and responsive header hierarchy.

## [0.3.0] - 2026-10-28

### Added
- **First-Class OpenCode Terminal (TUI) Support (`./tui`)**:
  - Full-featured TUI plugin adapter utilizing OpenTUI (`@opentui/solid` and `@opentui/core`).
  - **Conflict-Free Keybindings & Commands**:
    - `Alt+T` / `/translate [text]` (alias: `/tr`): Instantly translate clipboard text or custom input.
    - `Alt+Shift+T` / `/translate-last` (alias: `/trl`): Translate the last assistant turn in current session.
    - `Alt+P` / `/translate-panel` (alias: `/trp`): Toggle persistent translation side panel (`session.panel`).
    - `/translate-config`: Interactive TUI configuration dialog for target languages and engine modes.
  - **Scrollable Multiline Translation Modal (`TranslationModal`)**:
    - Centered high-contrast modal dialog replacing single-line selectors.
    - Full word wrapping (`wrapMode="word"`) displaying extensive multi-paragraph translations and code blocks without truncation.
    - Dedicated scroll container (`<scrollbox>`) with keyboard scrolling (`↑`/`↓`, `j`/`k`, `PageUp`/`PageDown`).
    - Quick actions: `y` (copy to clipboard), `Enter` (copy and close), `p` (open in side panel), `q` / `Esc` (dismiss).
  - **Seamless In-Place Side Panel Updates**:
    - When the side panel is open, pressing `Alt+T` or `Alt+Shift+T` updates the translation in-place inside the panel without opening popup dialogs.
    - Displays non-intrusive confirmation toast (`✓ Перевод обновлён в панели`).
  - **Interactive Side Panel (`session.panel`)**:
    - Real-time translation viewer with word wrap and persistent scrolling.
    - Visual focus tracking indicator (`[фокус]` / `(клик для фокуса)`).
    - Quick hotkeys when focused:
      - `t`: Translate current clipboard.
      - `l`: Translate last assistant response.
      - `y`: Copy Markdown translation to clipboard.
      - `m`: Cycle engine mode on the fly (`AUTO` ⇄ `FAST` ⇄ `LLM`).
      - `f`: Toggle full-screen panel presentation.
      - `q` / `Esc`: Close side panel.
  - **Interactive TUI Configuration (`/translate-config`)**:
    - Select target languages (e.g. `ru, en` or custom comma-separated list).
    - Switch engine mode (`AUTO` / `FAST` / `LLM`).
    - Reset settings to defaults with durable persistence via `context.storage.store`.
  - **Cross-Platform Clipboard Engine**:

## 🛠️ Local Development Setup

### Prerequisites
- **Node.js**: v22.0.0 or higher.
- **OpenCode Desktop**: v2.2.0 or newer.

### Getting Started

1. Clone the repository:
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/Realmagnum/opencode-translate-selection.git
   cd opencode-translate-selection
   ```

2. Install dependencies:
   ```bash
   npm install
   ```

3. Link the plugin into your global OpenCode configuration (`~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`):
   ```jsonc
   {
     "plugins": [
       "/absolute/path/to/opencode-translate-selection"
     ]
   }
   ```

4. Start Vite in watch mode:
   ```bash
   npm run watch
   ```
   OpenCode Desktop automatically detects changes to `dist/gui-experimental.cjs` and reloads the GUI in real time without restarting the app.

## 📐 Architecture Overview

The plugin follows OpenCode's dual-process architecture:

- **Window Process (`src/popup.tsx`, `src/formatter-view.tsx`, `src/settings-view.tsx`)**:
  - Rendered with SolidJS into OpenCode Desktop's DOM tree.
  - Mounts in the `window.bottom` slot and renders floating tooltips with `<Portal>`.
  - Captures selections via `window.getSelection()`, calculates bounding boxes, and handles user interactions.
- **Electron Main Process (`src/translate.ts`, `src/llm-engine.ts`, `src/shield.ts`)**:
  - Handles network operations (Google Translate, MyMemory API) without renderer CORS or CSP restrictions.
  - Calls `client.session.generate()` for structured LLM translations outside conversation history.
  - Manages the LRU translation cache.
- **IPC Contract (`src/contract.ts`)**:
  - Typed bridge between Window and Main using Effect `Schema`.
